title: Cucurbitacin B attenuates osteoarthritis development by inhibiting NLRP3 inflammasome activation and pyroptosis through activating Nrf2/HO-1 pathway.
authors: Lou, Chao; Fang, Yuqin; Mei, Yifan; Hu, Wei; Sun, Liaojun; Jin, Chen; Chen, Hua; Zheng, Wenhao
one_liner_zh: 该文研究葫芦素B通过Nrf2/HO-1通路抑制NLRP3炎症小体治疗骨关节炎，分子对接仅涉及小分子-蛋白，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Osteoarthritis (OA) is a complicated joint disorder characterized by inflammation that causes joint destruction. Cucurbitacin B (CuB) is a naturally occurring triterpenoid compound derived from plants in the Cucurbitaceae family. The aim of this study is to investigate the potential role and mechanisms of CuB in a mouse model of OA. This study identified the key targets and potential pathways of CuB through network pharmacology analysis. In vivo and in vitro studies confirmed the potential mechanisms of CuB in OA. Through network pharmacology, 54 potential targets for CuB in treating OA were identified. The therapeutic potential of CuB is associated with the nod-like receptor pyrin domain 3 (NLRP3) inflammasome and pyroptosis. Molecular docking results indicate a strong binding affinity of CuB to nuclear factor erythroid 2-related factor 2 (Nrf2) and p65. In vitro experiments demonstrate that CuB effectively inhibits the expression of pro-inflammatory factors induced by interleukin-1beta (IL-1beta), including cyclooxygenase-2, inducible nitric oxide synthase, IL-1beta, and IL-18. CuB inhibits the degradation of type II collagen and aggrecan in the extracellular matrix (ECM), as well as the expression of matrix metalloproteinase-13 and a disintegrin and metalloproteinase with thrombospondin motifs-5. CuB protects cells by activating the Nrf2/hemeoxygenase-1 (HO-1) pathway and inhibiting nuclear factor-kappaB (NF-kappaB)/NLRP3 inflammasome-mediated pyroptosis. Moreover, in vivo experiments show that CuB can slow down cartilage degradation in an OA mouse model. CuB effectively prevents the progression of OA by inhibiting inflammation in chondrocytes and ECM degradation. This action is further mediated through the activation of the Nrf2/HO-1 pathway to inhibit NF-kappaB/NLRP3 inflammasome activation. Thus, CuB is a potential therapeutic agent for OA.
abstract_zh: 骨关节炎（OA）是一种复杂的关节疾病，其特征为炎症导致关节破坏。葫芦素B（CuB）是一种天然存在的三萜类化合物，来源于葫芦科植物。本研究旨在探讨CuB在OA小鼠模型中的潜在作用及机制。通过网络药理学分析，本研究确定了CuB的关键靶点和潜在通路。体内和体外研究证实了CuB在OA中的潜在机制。通过网络药理学，共鉴定出CuB治疗OA的54个潜在靶点。CuB的治疗潜力与结节样受体热蛋白结构域3（NLRP3）炎症小体和细胞焦亡相关。分子对接结果显示，CuB与核因子E2相关因子2（Nrf2）和p65具有强结合亲和力。体外实验表明，CuB有效抑制由白细胞介素-1β（IL-1β）诱导的促炎因子表达，包括环氧化酶-2、诱导型一氧化氮合酶、IL-1β和IL-18。CuB抑制细胞外基质（ECM）中II型胶原和聚集蛋白聚糖的降解，以及基质金属蛋白酶-13和含血小板反应蛋白基序的解整合素金属蛋白酶-5的表达。CuB通过激活Nrf2/血红素加氧酶-1（HO-1）通路并抑制核因子-κB（NF-κB）/NLRP3炎症小体介导的细胞焦亡来保护细胞。此外，体内实验显示，CuB能减缓OA小鼠模型中的软骨退化。CuB通过抑制软骨细胞炎症和ECM降解，有效阻止OA的进展。这一作用进一步通过激活Nrf2/HO-1通路抑制NF-κB/NLRP3炎症小体激活来介导。因此，CuB是OA的潜在治疗药物。
